• Low Effort - Harvest-Only
    Fully Automated, ideal for those who want fresh produce without lifting a finger. Just plug in, harvest, and enjoy.
  • Moderate Effort - Guided Growth
    For those who enjoy some hands-on time (15-30 minutes/week) with smart tech support. Get involved without the hassle.
  • High Effort - Hands-On Mastery
    For dedicated growers who love involvement (3-6 hours/week) and experimenting.
